mock_data.title: The Dangers of Passive Smoking
mock_data.passage:
Recent research has revealed that passive smoking, even over a short period of time, such as thirty minutes, can temporarily damage a non-smoker's heart. Experts have been warning for some time of the health risks caused by inhaling the smoke from other people's cigarettes, but the average person does not yet seem to be very aware of these.

People in most countries are now quite well informed about the dangers of smoking, whether or not they choose to act on the information and stop smoking. They know, for example, that smoking can lead to respiratory diseases, including serious diseases, such as lung cancer. However, their knowledge of the consequences of passive smoking seems very limited.

Most people who do not smoke regard smoking as an antisocial habit which causes them some discomfort, rather than as a danger to their health. They may object to a smoky atmosphere, dirty ashtrays, or the mess made by smokers dropping cigarette ends, or to discarded cigarette butts. They may always sit, when possible, in no-smoking areas of restaurants or other public places. Still, many of them do not yet realize that being in the company of smokers can make them actually ill.

Yet, it has been known for some years that passive smoking can, to a lesser extent, cause the same respiratory diseases that smoking tobacco leads to. Sufferers from asthma often find that their condition worsens in an atmosphere that is thick with cigarette smoke.

Smokers, who are concerned about their health, can try to kick the habit which is one of the most common forms of addiction. To do so, they may, perhaps, rely on their willpower or, perhaps, wear nicotine patches. Other people, however, can do little but avoid the company of smokers, especially those who chain-smoke.

If you want to avoid the risks of passive smoking, you can take some simple precautions. Always avoid the smoking areas of public places and ban smoking in your home. Also, you can tactfully ask your friends not to light up in front of you. Who knows? They might just start worrying about their own health.

mock_data.passageB2:
New research has highlighted that even brief exposure to passive smoking, such as just thirty minutes, can cause temporary harm to a non-smoker's heart. While experts have been raising awareness about the health risks associated with breathing in other people's cigarette smoke for some time, public understanding of these dangers seems to be lagging behind.

In most countries, people are generally well-informed about the dangers of smoking itself. Whether or not they choose to quit, they are aware that smoking can lead to respiratory illnesses, including serious conditions like lung cancer. However, their understanding of the consequences of passive smoking appears to be much more limited. They may not realize the severity of the threat.

Many non-smokers view smoking as an inconsiderate habit that causes them discomfort, rather than recognizing it as a genuine health hazard. They might object to smoky environments, dirty ashtrays, or the litter caused by discarded cigarette ends. They may consistently choose non-smoking sections in restaurants or other public places. Yet, a large number of them still don't fully grasp that being around smokers can actually make them sick, which is a cause for concern.

It's been known for several years that passive smoking can, to a lesser degree, cause the same respiratory diseases that active smoking does. People with asthma often find that their symptoms worsen significantly in environments filled with cigarette smoke. This can trigger an attack.

Smokers who are concerned about their health can try to break free from their addiction, which is one of the most common forms of dependence. They might rely on their own willpower, or they might use nicotine patches as a tool to help them quit. However, non-smokers often have limited options other than avoiding the company of smokers, particularly those who chain-smoke. This may lead to social isolation.

If you want to minimize the risks of passive smoking, you can take some simple steps. Always avoid designated smoking areas in public places and enforce a no-smoking policy in your home. Furthermore, you can politely ask your friends not to smoke in your presence. You never know, they might even start to reconsider their own smoking habits, and this could prompt them to think about their health.

These small changes can contribute significantly to your overall health and well-being. Don't underestimate the cumulative effect of protecting yourself from secondhand smoke. It is paramount to prioritize your health.
mock_data.passageC1:
Mounting evidence, culminating in recent studies, has revealed the insidious nature of passive smoking, demonstrating that even brief exposure, such as a mere thirty minutes, can precipitate transient cardiovascular compromise in non-smokers. While experts have long cautioned against the deleterious health effects stemming from involuntary inhalation of secondhand smoke, public awareness regarding the gravity of these risks remains, disconcertingly, suboptimal.

Despite widespread dissemination of information concerning the perils of active smoking, including its causal link to respiratory illnesses and life-threatening conditions like lung cancer, a significant disparity exists in the public's comprehension of the ramifications of passive smoking. Whether individuals choose to heed warnings about active smoking is a matter of personal agency; however, the pervasive lack of understanding regarding the dangers faced by those exposed to secondhand smoke represents a critical public health concern.

For many non-smokers, the primary objection to smoking centers on its perceived antisocial nature and the immediate discomfort it engenders – the offensive odour, the unsightly ashtrays, the ubiquitous litter of discarded cigarette ends. While they may assiduously seek out smoke-free zones in public spaces, a substantial number remain unaware that mere proximity to smokers can render them susceptible to tangible health detriments. The notion that secondhand smoke is simply an annoyance, rather than a genuine health hazard, continues to hold sway.

The scientific community has, for some time, acknowledged that passive smoking can, albeit to a lesser degree than active smoking, induce similar respiratory ailments. Individuals with pre-existing conditions, such as asthma, often experience a marked exacerbation of their symptoms in environments saturated with cigarette smoke. Indeed, the impact of secondhand smoke on respiratory health is now irrefutable.

Smokers who are genuinely concerned about their well-being may elect to break free from their nicotine addiction, a notoriously difficult undertaking. Their strategies might range from leveraging sheer willpower to employing nicotine replacement therapies, such as transdermal patches. Non-smokers, however, are largely limited to mitigating their exposure by avoiding smokers, particularly those who habitually chain-smoke.

To mitigate the risks associated with passive smoking, individuals can adopt simple, yet effective, preventative measures. These include consistently avoiding designated smoking areas in public settings, enforcing a strict no-smoking policy within one's own home, and, where appropriate, politely requesting that friends refrain from smoking in their presence. Such actions might, perchance, even prompt those friends to re-evaluate their own smoking habits and prioritize their health. It is a collective responsibility to foster environments free from the insidious threat of secondhand smoke.

mock_data.translation:
Yaqinda olib borilgan tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatdiki, passiv chekish, hatto o'ttiz daqiqa kabi qisqa vaqt ichida ham chekmaydigan odamning yuragiga vaqtincha zarar yetkazishi mumkin. Mutaxassislar boshqa odamlarning sigaret tutunini nafas olish orqali yuzaga keladigan sog'liq uchun xavf haqida bir muncha vaqtdan beri ogohlantirmoqdalar, ammo oddiy odam hali ham bulardan juda xabardor emasdek.

Aksariyat mamlakatlardagi odamlar chekishning xavflari haqida ma'lumot bilan yetarli darajada ta'minlangan, ular bu ma'lumotga amal qilish va chekishni to'xtatishni tanlashlaridan qat'i nazar. Ular, masalan, chekish o'pka kasalliklariga, jumladan, o'pka saratoni kabi jiddiy kasalliklarga olib kelishi mumkinligini bilishadi. Biroq, ularning passiv chekishning oqibatlari haqidagi bilimlari juda cheklangan.

Chekmaydigan ko'pchilik odamlar chekishni sog'lig'iga xavf sifatida emas, balki ularga noqulaylik keltiradigan antisosial odat sifatida ko'rishadi. Ular tutunli muhitga, iflos kulgonga yoki chekuvchilar tomonidan tashlab yuborilgan sigaret uchlariga e'tiroz bildirishlari mumkin. Ular iloji boricha restoranlarda yoki boshqa jamoat joylarida chekish taqiqlangan joylarda o'tirishlari mumkin. Shunga qaramay, ularning ko'pchiligi chekuvchilar bilan birga bo'lish ularni haqiqatan ham kasal qilishi mumkinligini hali tushunmaydilar.

Shunga qaramay, passiv chekish ma'lum darajada tamaki chekish olib keladigan o'pka kasalliklarini keltirib chiqarishi bir necha yillardan beri ma'lum. Astma bilan og'rigan odamlar o'z holatlarining sigaret tutuni qalin atmosferada yomonlashishini ko'pincha sezishadi.

O'z sog'lig'i haqida tashvishlanadigan chekuvchilar addiktsiyaning eng keng tarqalgan shakllaridan biri bo'lgan odatni tashlab yuborishga harakat qilishlari mumkin. Buning uchun ular iroda kuchiga tayanishlari yoki nikotin yamog'laridan foydalanishlari mumkin. Biroq, boshqa odamlar chekuvchilar, ayniqsa zanjir chekuvchilar bilan birga bo'lishdan qochishdan boshqa narsa qila olmaydilar.

Agar siz passiv chekish xavfidan qochmoqchi bo'lsangiz, bir nechta oddiy ehtiyot choralarini ko'rishingiz mumkin. Har doim jamoat joylarining chekish zonalaridan qoching va uyingizda chekishni taqiqlang. Shuningdek, do'stlaringizdan sizning oldingizda chekmasliklarini muloyimlik bilan so'rashingiz mumkin. Kim biladi? Ular o'z sog'liqlari haqida o'ylay boshlashlari mumkin.

Mutaxassislar odamlarni boshqalarning sigaretlaridan chiqqan tutunni nafas olish xavfi haqida ogohlantirib kelmoqda. Ammo ko'pchilik bu xavflar haqida hali ko'p narsa bilmaydi.

Ko'pgina mamlakatlarda odamlar chekishning xavflari haqida ko'p narsa bilishadi. Ular chekish o'pka saratoni kabi nafas olish muammolariga olib kelishi mumkinligini bilishadi. Ular bu ma'lumotga e'tibor bermaslikni tanlashlari mumkin, lekin ular buni bilishadi. Biroq, ular passiv chekishning xavflari haqida ko'p narsa bilishmaydi.

Chekmaydigan odamlarning aksariyati chekishni bezovta qiluvchi deb o'ylashadi. Ular bu ularga qandaydir noqulaylik tug'diradi, lekin ularning sog'lig'iga xavf solmaydi deb o'ylashadi. Ularga tutunli havo, iflos kuldonlar yoki yerda yotgan sigaret qoldiqlari yoqmasligi mumkin. Ular restoranlarda chekilmaydigan joylarda o'tirishni tanlashlari mumkin. Ammo ko'pchilik hali ham chekuvchilarning yonida bo'lish ularni kasal qilishi mumkinligini tushunishmaydi.

Biz bir necha yildirki, passiv chekish chekish bilan bir xil nafas olish muammolariga olib kelishi mumkinligini bilamiz. Bu unchalik yomon bo'lmasligi mumkin, ammo bu hali ham muammo. Astma bilan kasallangan odamlar havoda sigaret tutuni ko'p bo'lganda o'zlarini yomon his qilishadi.

Sog'lig'idan xavotirda bo'lgan chekuvchilar chekishni tashlashga harakat qilishlari mumkin. Chekish - bu keng tarqalgan odat. Ular o'zlarining iroda kuchidan foydalanib yoki nikotinli yamoqlardan foydalanib to'xtashga harakat qilishlari mumkin. Boshqa odamlar faqat chekuvchilardan, ayniqsa ko'p chekadiganlardan uzoqroq yurishga harakat qilishlari mumkin.

Agar siz passiv chekish xavfidan saqlanmoqchi bo'lsangiz, bir nechta oddiy narsalarni qilishingiz mumkin. Har doim jamoat joylarida chekiladigan joylardan uzoqroq turing. Uyingizda chekishni taqiqlang. Shuningdek, do'stlaringizdan sizning yaqiningizda chekmaslikni odob bilan so'rashingiz mumkin. Ehtimol, ular ham o'z sog'lig'i haqida o'ylay boshlashadi!

Ko'pgina mamlakatlarda odamlar chekishning o'zi xavflari haqida yaxshi xabardor. Ular chekishni tashlashni tanlaydimi yoki yo'qmi, ular chekish nafas olish yo'llari kasalliklariga, shu jumladan o'pka saratoni kabi jiddiy kasalliklarga olib kelishi mumkinligini bilishadi. Biroq, ularning passiv chekish oqibatlari haqidagi tushunchasi ancha cheklangan ko'rinadi. Ular xavfning jiddiyligini anglamasligi mumkin.

Ko'p chekmaydiganlar chekishni haqiqiy sog'liq uchun xavf sifatida tan olishdan ko'ra, ularga noqulaylik tug'diradigan e'tiborsiz odat deb bilishadi. Ular tutunli muhitga, iflos kuldonlarga yoki tashlab yuborilgan sigaret qoldiqlaridan kelib chiqadigan axlatga e'tiroz bildirishlari mumkin. Ular doimiy ravishda restoranlar yoki boshqa jamoat joylarida chekilmaydigan joylarni tanlashlari mumkin. Shunga qaramay, ularning ko'pchiligi chekuvchilarning atrofida bo'lish ularni kasal qilishi mumkinligini to'liq anglamaydilar, bu esa xavotirga sabab bo'ladi.

Bir necha yildan beri ma'lumki, passiv chekish faol chekish kabi nafas olish yo'llari kasalliklarini kamroq darajada keltirib chiqarishi mumkin. Astma bilan kasallangan odamlar ko'pincha sigaret tutuni bilan to'ldirilgan muhitda ularning alomatlari sezilarli darajada kuchayganini aniqlaydilar. Bu xurujni qo'zg'atishi mumkin.

Sog'lig'i haqida qayg'uradigan chekuvchilar o'zlarining giyohvandlikdan qutulishga harakat qilishlari mumkin, bu esa qaramlikning eng keng tarqalgan shakllaridan biridir. Ular o'z irodasiga tayanishi yoki chekishni tashlashga yordam beradigan vosita sifatida nikotinli yamoqlardan foydalanishi mumkin. Biroq, chekmaydiganlar ko'pincha chekuvchilar, ayniqsa, tinimsiz chekadiganlar bilan birga bo'lishdan qochishdan boshqa imkoniyatga ega emaslar. Bu esa ijtimoiy izolyatsiyaga olib kelishi mumkin.

Agar siz passiv chekish xavfini kamaytirishni istasangiz, oddiy qadamlar qo'yishingiz mumkin. Jamoat joylarida chekish uchun ajratilgan joylardan doimo qoching va uyingizda chekishga yo'l qo'ymaslik siyosatini joriy qiling. Bundan tashqari, do'stlaringizdan sizning huzuringizda chekmaslikni iltimos qilishingiz mumkin. Bilmaysiz, ular hatto o'zlarining chekish odatlari haqida qayta o'ylab ko'rishlari mumkin va bu ularni sog'lig'i haqida o'ylashga undashi mumkin.

Bu kichik o'zgarishlar sizning umumiy sog'lig'ingiz va farovonligingizga sezilarli hissa qo'shishi mumkin. O'zingizni ikkilamchi tutundan himoya qilishning yig'indisi ta'sirini kam baholamang. Sog'lig'ingizni birinchi o'ringa qo'yish muhim.
